tool_input_args.value:
import re

lines = sales_csv.strip().replace('\r\n', '\n').split('\n')
header = lines[0].split(',')
rows = [line.split(',') for line in lines[1:] if line.strip()]

# Filter: James Okafor + won
james_won = [r for r in rows if r[1].strip() == "James Okafor" and r[6].strip() == "won"]

# Build summary
total_revenue = sum(int(r[4]) for r in james_won)
product_breakdown = {}
region_breakdown = {}
month_breakdown = {}

for r in james_won:
    product = r[3].strip()
    region = r[2].strip()
    amount = int(r[4])
    close_date = r[5].strip()
    month = close_date[:7]  # e.g. "2026-07"

    product_breakdown[product] = product_breakdown.get(product, 0) + amount
    region_breakdown[region] = region_breakdown.get(region, 0) + amount
    month_breakdown[month] = month_breakdown.get(month, 0) + amount

# Print deal listing
summary = "=== James Okafor — Won Deals (Q3 2026) ===\n\n"
summary += f"{'Deal':<6} {'Product':<25} {'Region':<8} {'Amount':>10}   {'Close Date'}\n"
summary += "-" * 70 + "\n"
for r in james_won:
    summary += f"{r[0]:<6} {r[3].strip():<25} {r[2].strip():<8} ${int(r[4]):>9,}   {r[5].strip()}\n"

summary += "-" * 70 + "\n"
summary += f"{'TOTAL':<6} {'':<25} {'':<8} ${total_revenue:>9,}\n"

summary += f"\nTotal won deals: {len(james_won)}\n"
summary += f"Total won revenue: ${total_revenue:,}\n"

summary += "\n--- By Product ---\n"
for prod, amt in sorted(product_breakdown.items()):
    summary += f"  {prod}: ${amt:,} ({len([r for r in james_won if r[3].strip() == prod])} deals)\n"

summary += "\n--- By Region ---\n"
for reg, amt in sorted(region_breakdown.items()):
    summary += f"  {reg}: ${amt:,}\n"

summary += "\n--- By Month ---\n"
for mo, amt in sorted(month_breakdown.items()):
    summary += f"  {mo}: ${amt:,}\n"

# Also note his pending deal
james_pending = [r for r in rows if r[1].strip() == "James Okafor" and r[6].strip() == "pending"]
if james_pending:
    summary += "\n--- Pending (not included above) ---\n"
    for r in james_pending:
        summary += f"  {r[0]}: {r[3].strip()}, {r[2].strip()}, ${int(r[4]):,} (close date: {r[5].strip()})\n"

print(summary)
